# IQVIA

> Global leader in healthcare analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services connecting healthcare professionals, researchers, and life sciences companies.

IQVIA provides data-driven solutions for the life sciences industry, including clinical research networks, healthcare analytics platforms, and enterprise tools for medical professionals and pharmaceutical companies. The platform supports medical research, patient care optimization, and healthcare decision-making through technology and data insights.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare Analytics
- Clinical Research
- Medical Research Networks
- Life Sciences Solutions
- Healthcare Professionals
- Patient Care
- Medical Community
- Survey Participation
- SSO Authentication
- Corporate Portal Access
- Brand Management
- Healthcare Technology
- Research Studies

## Medical Research & Clinical Networks

- [Docnet - Medical Research](https://docnet.solutions.iqvia.com/): Docnet network for healthcare professionals in medical research studies

## Enterprise & Brand Management

- [IQVIA Brand Portal](https://brandworld.iqvia.com/): IQVIA Brand Portal login page with SSO authentication for account access
